# Rocky Mountain Safety by Safe Hands

> Practical, certified industrial safety training, pipeline Operator Qualification (OQ) evaluations, and mobile occupational health testing in Durango, Colorado and across the Four Corners region (CO, NM, AZ, UT).

## Business Overview
- **Name:** Rocky Mountain Safety by Safe Hands
- **Headquarters:** 858 Main St, Unit 203, Durango, CO 81301
- **Phone:** (970) 764-8799
- **Main Office (Safe Hands):** (432) 231-2207
- **Email:** L.Sanchez@RockyMtnSafety.com
- **Website:** https://rockymtnsafety.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (After-hours & weekends by appointment)
- **Coverage:** Southwest Colorado (Durango), San Juan Basin NM (Farmington, Aztec, Bloomfield), Northern & Eastern Arizona, Southeastern Utah

## Services & Capabilities
- **Operator Qualification (OQ):** Veriforce, Energy Worldnet (EWN), OQSG, ITS, and ISNetworld covered task evaluations, knowledge verifications, and compliance audits for pipeline contractors under DOT and PHMSA standards.
- **Safety Training:** SafeLandUSA / Basic 7.0, PEC H2S Clear, Basin United Orientation, OSHA 10 & 30 Hour (General Industry and Construction), CPR/First Aid/AED, Forklift certification, and MSHA surface mining safety. Bilingual instruction available.
- **Mobile Health & Testing:** Certified mobile medical units dispatched directly to company yards and field sites. DOT and Non-DOT drug/alcohol collections, quantitative respirator fit testing (QNFT), audiometric hearing testing, and occupational physical exams.
- **NCCER Workforce Development:** Accredited craft curricula, standardized assessments, and portable credentials for industrial trades.
